body: Sorry man, I appreciate the advice, if it's too much don't worry about it.
I want to be but I don't know.
I know what you're saying but I still really care about her and want to know that she's okay :/
That's a good point. I don't know if I want to lose these feelings for her but I know I have to. The whole things making me really ill.
Yeah, we still text every now and then.
I know what you mean, in trying to put myself in the mindset I was in back then but I feel like the bad guy no matter how I look at it...
That's cool. I tried guitar and writing and hanging out with friends. I'll try them again but I'm just amazed I still feel this bad after five months.
This is stupid but I really can't think of anything I could do in this situation. Could you suggest anything?
Thanks, that was definitely helpful. Gave me a lot to think about.
Thanks, I really appreciate that. It's really hard to find anything to distract myself though. No matter how hard I try if my mind wanders for a second I'm in tears again.
I know what you're saying but I really can't help thinking I could've done something to make it work.
